translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nimu la! Ninge Jud, mzle Jemes kxtopwz. X wztr-nrbalqbo mz Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. Ryrbo bamu, nimu kcng tqkqle Gct Trte mz nzrlxngitingr, tzmncpxmqng mz nivz lrde. Aclvele nzrlxngiti-krmu nakrlzbzle mzli kc Jiszs Kxnzmcpx nayzlu-mou-ngrmle.
Krka'-ngrne kx natwz-zvzamu nzrmrlzngr, nivz, x nzmnc-zpwxngr. Eu, angida.
Kxnzakrlz Kxnzpokiang

Mzlengeng x inwengeng, mzli kc kai suti drtwrnge nzryr-krbo bamu mz nzlu-krgu kxmrna mz Jiszs. A' tekqtrpex drtwrnge, murde kzdung da kx nzprtzbzng bamu. X mzli ka suti zlwz drtwrnge nzrngidrlvz-ngrbo bamu mz nzvec-krmu murde natu-amqngiamu mz da kcng tqlxngitiku. Murde da angidr lcng tzaprcpemlr bagu, nalolvz-amqngiku, nigu doa kxnztrng.

Mzli ka kzdung kxdrka'-ngrng nzataleo-lzbqpebzng mz mzlirmu. A' trkrlzwamuu kx nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzmnclz-ngrbz mz Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, kc tqngi txpwz Kxetu rgu mz da amrlx. Nztwz-rbrpelr Nrpakxmrlz mz nzrpi-krdr trvz-rbru mz nigu kxnzrlxngiting mz nzrmwimingr doa kx trngiu krnalzgu, murde sa naipq-zvz Gct nigu mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz. A' mzli kc pnz, profet nzyrolr mz Nzryrngrkxtr kx leplz kxnzmulr lcng sa na-ayrplapxng mz Hxl.
Kxnzaleng Alwx Mzli Kc Bqnc Nzayrplapxng

Krlzpeamu be kcng amrlx napi-ngrbo bamu, mz leplz kcng tzmncng mz alwx mzli kc bqnc tzayrplapxng. A' brngz nzadcpx-mou-ngrm bagu. Murde arlapxpe Yawe lr Israel, leplz nedeng kcng tqmcpxle, mz nzngini-krdr kxnzawz-nrbalqng mrkc Ijipt. A' mz nibrde ayrplapx-kzle kzdung nidr mz nzodati-krde krkcng trnzlxngitilru nide.

X nayc kz mz drtwrmu enjrl kcng tzvecpx-lzbqng mz nzaclve-krdr mz zmatq ngrdr. Nzesablqtitxdr mrnyzdr. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, ayrplapxpe Gct nidr mz nzpe-alo-krde nidr x nzamnc-krdeleng mz presin kx wx-nzlongr. X namncng elr nakrlzbzle mzli kc nayzlu-ngrm Jiszs mz nzayrplapx-mou-krdeleng.

X nadctipx kz drtwrmu lr Sodom x lr Gomora, x lr mztea kcng tzesonetrpzng. Mz nqmq lcpwz, nzrmwiming badr doa kx trngiu krnalzdrng mz nzalvengr da kxmrlz mz da kx trka-esz'ngr. Mz nzmu-krde lc, Gct angcle leplz lcdeng x mztea nyzdrng mz nyr kx vzom mz bongavz, murde nakrlz-ngrgu kx sa na-ayrplapx-kzle leplz kxdrka'-ngrng amrlx mz nyr kx ngc alo.
Leplz Kcng Mzli Ka Tzalvztr-rbrng Sa Na-ayrplapx-kzng

Mz nqmq lcpwz, kxdrka'ngr lcng tzprtrpzng bamu nzale-kzlr da lcng. Murde nzrpilr kx Kxetu kx rkabz nzobq-rmwiblengr kcng tzvz-nqblqlr, tqrlr-ngrbzle badr nzrtrngz-abeane-ngrbz da kx myangr drtq. A' mz nzale-krdr alwx lcde, nzatrkatilr nrkrdrtqdr mz nzobqkr Kxetu. X nzobqszolr zmatq ngr natqde. X nzpibqtilr enjrl nedeng kxnzluling.

A' trtakitrdeu nzamyalz-lzbq-krdr nzmyaszlz-krdr Loukxtr. Murde Setzn rpwa'-ngrbzle mz Maekol, Nardr Enjrl, nztwz-krde namz ngr Mosis mz nzngini-krde kxrnibq. A' Maekol tramyalz-lzbq-pnzu mz Loukxtr, mz nzpnanati-krde Setzn. A' rpi-alzubzle kx, “Napnanatile nim Kxetu!”

A' kxnzalvztr-rbr lcng nzpibqtilr da kznikeng tryrplatitru nardr. X mou, nqmq krdr vz-nqblq-txpwzle nqmq kr animol kzpetong, kx trpnzngr nardr. X trnzxplrlvzlru nrkrdrtqdr, a' nzvz-nqblq-alzulr nike xngibz nrkrdrtqdr, kcng tzbatrpzlr nzprtrngr mz zngya ngr drtwr Kxetu x nzayrplapx-krde nidr.

Agrmplzng! Murde sa na-ayrplapxng mz nzo-zli-krdr lrpzki nyz ncblo kxdrka'-ngrng kcng bqnc. Nzapulr Ken kc tqdrka'ngr. X nzvqti drtqdr nzalengr alwx, da kc tqwai profet Balam kc bqnc, mz nzmailz-krde lr Israel mz nzrtrngz-abeane-ngrbz alwx, murde nartwz-ngrde trau. X leplz lcng nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzmnclz-ngrbz mz Kxetu, da kc tqwai Kora kc bqnc. X sa naodati-kzng mz alwx lc, da kc tqwai Kora.

Leplz lcng trnzamrluelru kztedrng mzli kc tqmu-lxblr-ngrnamu x mzli kc tqodu-lxblr-ngrnamu mz Nzmungrkxtr. Murde mzli lcdeng nzalelr da kx myangr drtq mz nzmutu-krdr x nzrmnq-zlwz-krdr. Nzapulr mapz kx wxlzngr lcsu, murde nzbatrpzlr nzodatingr leplz. X nzapulr kxnzaclveng sip, a' nzaoti txpwz drtwrdr nidr esz'-krdr. X nzapu-kzlr dcbz kxmingr kx twzne nenq mz mzli r nepi boi, murde da kx nzalvztr-ngrdr trokatrleu nzrlxngitikr leplz. X nzapu-kzlr nounc kx trpengr nradr murde nzmzpeng, x nzmz-moung mzli kc tzamrtu-ngrdrng.

X kxnzalvztr-rbr lcng nzapu-kzlr nrc kxetuting mz nabz trlipu kxetu kx yrplao mz nabz drta' x nzrlaszlr dcvi kxnzlvemlr. Murde nqmq krdr lc trmrlzu atrkatile leplz. X mou nzapulr vri kx nzvz-lvilr nzti rdr, murde nzamnc-mrbrlr krkcng tzrma-nqblqng. Delc sa na-amnc-along me yc-zlwzngr nzlo mz Hxl.
Inck vzpxm mz nrpr ngr ncblo krarlimz mz nibr Adzm. Plzpx-kaile leplz lcng tzdrka'-ngrng, mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Kxetu sa tqvzmipemle siu ngr enjrl nedeng,

murde napipxbzle mz leplz amrlx kx nztubqng o trtingr. X mzli lc sa napipx-kzpzle mz kxdrka'-ngrng amrlx kx nzvz-rbrng mz da kxdrka'-ngrng amrlx kcng tzalelr. Murde nzvz-nqblqlr nqmq kxdrka'-ngrng, x nzpivxi-ngrdr Kxetu mz natq kxdrka'-ngrng.”

Leplz lcng drtwrdr lc-zvz-ngrdr da kx prtzbz badr, murde drtwrdr tresapxu. X vz zvz nzvz-nqblq-krdr da kxdrka'ngr kx mrlzbz badr. Nzglqpx-lzbqng mz nzycmne-krdr x nztamitilr leplz murde namrlzbadr nidr.
Jud Lc-apqbzle Kztedeng
A' nimu, kx mzlengeng x inwengeng, nadctipx drtwrmu kx aposol neng Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx nzpi-kaipzlr bamu leplz lcng tzdrka'-ngrng, tzmncng mz mzlirmu.
Nzpibzlr bamu kx, “Mzli ka tqaenzli-ngrgu nzyzlu-krm Jiszs, leplz sa naxtrnga-ngrdr nigu kcng tzvz-nqblqlr nqmq krde. Sa navz-nqblqlr drtwr kxtrka kcng tqmrlzbz badr.”
X nidr leplz kcng tzbatrpzlr nzaki-lzbq-krmu mz nzalvztr-rbr-krdr. Nzvz-nqblqlr nqmq nr drtwrdr lcng tqdrka'ngr x Mqngrkxtr trmncpxpuu badr.

Mzlengeng x inwengeng, mzli ka tqaenzli-ngrnamu nzprtr-krmu mz nzlungr kxboi Heven, kc tqvzpxm mz nzryckr drtwr Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx x zmrlz ngrde, namnc-aepztrpzmu mz Gct mz nzlolvz-zvz-krmu nivz lrde. Natu-amqngiamu mz nzalvztrkr aposol, murde nzrlxngiti-krmu naetunepx zvz. X narlr-lzbq-ngrbzmu mz zmatq ngr Mqngrkxtr nzmailz-krde nimu mzli kznikeng krka'-ngrnamu.
Nayc mz drtwrmu leplz kx nabzdr ngrgo x na-axplrbzmu nzrlxngiti-krdr.

Narngidrlvz-ngrbzmu x na-apqtrpzmu drtwr leplz kcng tzesotrpzng mz nzprtr-krdr mz nyr ngr Hxl, murde narlapxng. X nayc mz drtwrmu krkcng tzale-zvzng alwx. A' bzkq odutr-lxblramu badr, murde alwx ngrdr ma tqaprctile nimu. Murde alwx ngrdr lcng nzapulr lrpz kxngangr kx angangrle kxrbxtrpz.
Jud Glqlzle Gct

Naglqpxku Yawe, Gct kc esz'txu, kc tqarlapxle nigu mz Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. Nide kc tqlolvz-amqngile nigu, murde ma tqtaoku mz alwx. X alqngile nabzgu, murde na-abrtz-ngrgu nztubq-krgu mzli kc tqvzmi-ngrde nigu mz nztutr-krbzku mz mzte, mz zluli rde Heven. Murde sc tqtakitrde nzangiongr, tqmyalz-esz'ngr, tqxplr-esz'ngr, x tqmatq-esz'ngr, da kc tqwai-pnzle mz noude, krlzmle mzli ka, x kxnamu-zvzpele lc, tqyc tqyc. Eu, angida. Delape. Ninge Jud.

footnotes.text: Jud lc ni-kzde mzle Jiszs. Mc mrkc wq mz ‘Natq Ngr Nzaplxtqngr Mz Nzryrkr Jud.’
Jiszs kamle bagu zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz, murde narngiscgu zmatq mz nzaovxio-krgu alwx. A' trngiu da kx rlr-ngrmle bagu nzale-zvz-krgu alwx.

5 Mc Nzkqlu-krdr dckrlzde kc 14. Lr Israel trnzbrtiu drtwrdr nzokatrkr Gct nidr mz nzaovxio-krdr ncblo kxnzwzpxng kxnzxplrng mz drtc' kc tqesalz-ngrbzle badr. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, krkcng trnzrlxngitiung trnzprtr-pnzung elr, a' nzrve-txpwzng lzke yiz nzpnu-pwx, vz vz nzbzng amrlx ngrdr. 6 Mc Nou 6:1-4. Be lc yc mz kzdq buk, drtqde 1 Inck. A' tryclzpuu mz Nzryrngrkxtr, x trkrlz-angidrkuu kx ngi da angidr o trtingr. Kxmule-esz', a' leplz mz mzli nyz Jud nzkrlztilr be lc. Mz 1 Inck, kzdung enjrl nzvzomqng Heven x nzmwiming kzdung olvz x nzyrng. A' krlc trvz-nqblqleu me pnz drtwr Gct, a' ngi nzalvengr da kxmrlz mz da kxtrka-esz'ngr.

8 Mzli kc Gct tqka-ngrbzle Loukxtr mz Mosis, ycmnekipxle enjrl. [Aposol 7:38, 53; Hibru 2:2] Mz drtwr lr Jiu, enjrl nzaclvelr Loukxtr x leplz nzmnclzbzng mz Lou. X nzlxngiti-kzlr kx Gct amncle enjrl esz' kc na-aclvele kzdq neidu, mz neidu amrlx mz nrlc. A' nzpnzkr drtwr leplz lcng le, nzmyaszlzlr enjrl lcng murde mz nzobq-rmwible-krdr. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, trnzmnclzpwzung mz Loukxtr kc tqkabz enjrl lcng mz Mosis. X nzalvztr-kzlr kx enjrl lcng nzkabzlr mz leplz lou, mz nzatrkati-krdr nidr, a' trvzpuu mz Gct. Mz nqmq lc, nzvecpx-lzbqng mz nzmnclz-krbzlr mz Loukxtr, x trnzamrluelru enjrl kcng tzaclvelr lou lc. Mc kz Rom 6:15-23 x 1 Korint 6:3. 9 Nzmu Maekol trnarngiscdeu zmatq mz nzryrlqngr drtwrde mz nzvz-nqblqngr Loukxtr, e trpnzngr kx rngisc kz zmatq lcde. Murde Gct txpwz esz'-krde kxmyaszlzle Loukxtr.

Nou 4 ycmnetr-ngrde Ken nznibq-krde mzlede. A' mz kzdung be nedr lr Jiu, Ken nqmq krde drka'ngr zlwz, murde alvztr-rbrle leplz mz nzangio-krdr drka' x mz nzrmwimingr doa kx trngiu krnalzdr. X be ngr Balam yc mz Nzkqlu-krdr dckrlzdrng 22-25, 31:16, Lou Kcpwz 23:4-5, Nemaea 13:2, x Nzaelwapxngr 2:14. Lr Jiu nzpilr kx Balam esabrtile lr Israel mz nzangio-krdr drka'ng x nzrmwimingr kxtrngiu krnalzdr, murde King Balak, kc tqngi enqmi rdr, xpe-kapqle nide mz nzale-krde da lc. Mc kz nzkqlu-krdr 16 kc tqycmnetr-ngrde nzpxtxpxkr Kora nzmnclz-krbzle mz Gct.
Nou 4:21-24 ycmnetr-ngrde Inck. Mc kz natq kxtopwz mz Jud 6.
